803679.desc: Place an arcane rune on the ground that dispels 3 harmful magic effects from allies in the radius, and purges 3 beneficial magic effects from enemies.

803748.name: Runic Tattoos: Arcane
803748.desc: Attune yourself to arcane, increasing your Arcane resistance by 5 and reducing the duration of harmful magic and curse effects against you by 20%.

804060.name: Permafrost Rune
804060.desc: Requires Frozen Target Inscribe a rune of permafrost and unleash it on an enemy, incapacitating them for 40 seconds (8 sec vs players). Damage taken will end the effect. Affected enemies are considered Frozen. Using this while in Runeshroud causes it to incur an -80% reduced cooldown.

804094.name: Windbreaker
804094.desc: While Weapon Engraving: Air is active, the damage of each strike of your Hurricane is increased by 30%.

804126.name: Augur's Shield
804126.desc: Regenerates 20% maximum mana and reduces damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

804127.name: Prismatic Blade
804127.desc: Strike an enemy for Weapon Damage plus 54 as Arcane, and cycle your Attunement twice.

804128.name: Runed Cascade

804129.name: Prismatic Knight
804129.desc: Increases your Armor by 100% of your Intellect and reduces damage done by 0%. Parrying an attack generates an Inscribed Rune and increases your Melee Attack Speed by 10% for 12 sec. Active while using a Two-Handed Melee Weapon.

804135.name: Magecraft Bolt
804135.desc: Fires a magical bolt at an enemy target, dealing Arcane, Frost or Fire damage, depending on whichever has the highest Spell Power modifier.

804151.name: Aspect of The Rune Knight
804151.desc: Reduces damage you take by 10%, increases maximum mana by 20%. Only 1 Aspect can be active at a time.

804509.name: Arcane Salvo (Melee)
